why: Wiring cycle 4 (docs/v3/cycles/wiring-4.md) converged at 0 P1 and 3 P2; two of the P2s are docs. wiring-4.1: the README's own `./table` example passes `mode: 'client'` to `useDataTable`, which fails `tsc` with `Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'Mode'` (`.evidence/cycle-wiring-4/v2-readme-mode.log`), while `use-data-table.md`, `saved-views.md` and `view-switch.md` pass `mode: { kind: 'client' }`; the README is the first file an author reads, and the cycle's one `.d.ts` read was this. wiring-4.2: `Lines`, `Bars`, `Heatmap` and `BandStrip` have no `docs/<name>.md` and `cartesian-chart.md` has no `subpath:` line (all five sit in `scripts/gen-docs.baseline.json`), though the AGENTS block's form table names `Lines` and `Bars` and tells the author to read `docs/<name>.md` before guessing; and the 26 primitive docs have empty `use when` and `never when` and print only their `*Variants` keys, so `badge.md` gives `DeltaBadge` a `tone: good, bad, neutral` where the component takes `value` and `polarity`, and `button.md` never names `loading`. Riding along: wiring-4.7 (README §1 has the author install the `app` peers that `init` installs itself, at a different `@tanstack/router-plugin` pin; `/basalt-design` step 6 cites internal builder ids `c10, c11, c13, n02`) and wiring-4.8 (`vite.md` calls `.basalt/sources.css` gitignored, but `init` writes no ignore line, so the first `git add -A` commits a generated file).
what: Every shipped doc an author reads in the first hour compiles and matches the types, and every public chart kind and primitive has a generated doc with its props.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-docs.ts, scripts/gen-docs.baseline.json and the docs they regenerate
the JSDoc of `src/charts/parts/{lines,bars,heatmap,band-strip,cartesian}.tsx` and of the `src/ui/*` components
packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/init (the `.gitignore` line only) and src/cli/doctor (check 12's tracked-file report only), their tests
a compile check for the README's tsx blocks, beside the recipe typecheck
change: (1) wiring-4.1: the README's table example passes `mode: { kind: 'client' }`; the README's `tsx` blocks are type-checked as the recipes are, so a drift like this fails the gate. (2) wiring-4.2: `Lines`, `Bars`, `Heatmap`, `BandStrip` and `CartesianChart` get their summary, `@useWhen` and `@neverWhen` and leave the gen-docs baseline, so each has a `docs/<name>.md` with its subpath; a primitive's generated doc prints the component's props (as the composites' docs do) beside its variants, with a filled `use when` and `never when`, and a variant that is not a prop (`DeltaBadge`'s tone) is not presented as one. (3) wiring-4.7: README §1 installs `basalt-ui` alone and says `init` installs the profile's peers at the pins it prints; `/basalt-design` step 6 names no internal builder ids. (4) wiring-4.8: `init` adds `.basalt/sources.css` to the app's `.gitignore` (creating the line once, never twice), and doctor check 12 reports the file when it is tracked.
commits: docs: or fix: in packages/basalt-ui, one commit per concern; the regenerated docs ride with the JSDoc that produced them.
proof: make check; `gen-docs --check` green with the baseline shorter by the five chart entries; the README compile check fails on `mode: 'client'` and passes on the fix.
